subject: New searchable webpage with DS references

messages.subject: New searchable webpage with DS references
parts:
Dear list members,

The two web pages containing links to online pdfs and references on=20
distance sampling, previously hosted at

(http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distance_pdfs.htm AND=20
http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distbiblio.html)

have now been replaced by a single web page, with currently 831=20
references of which 150 have links to corresponding pdfs. The major=20
advantage of it being that the new page is searchable, by looking for=20
strings of text using a "QuickSearch" box. If you want to see only the=20
references with pdf links to them just search for "pdf". The NEW address =
is:

http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distancesamplingreferences.h=
tml

An extra advantage, for those who use bibtex, is that all references can=20
be obtained in the bibtex format from the webpage. The abstracts of some=20
of the papers are also present.

Any suggestions, new references, typos, reports of dead links, etc are=20
welcome as usual. New references, even if no pdf is available, are most=20
welcome, preferably in the bibtex format. Is your extensive work on=20
distance sampling being ignored in the current list...? Let me know=20
about it and I'll fix it.

By the way, this is now a joint project with Eric Rexstad.

Hope it continues to be a helpful resource...

Tiago
